newsitem.title: CHINA: China steel output seen at 97 mln T in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China steel output seen at 97 mln T in 1996.

text.p: China is expected to produce an estimated 97 million tonnes of steel this year, up three million tonnes compared with 1995, the China News Service on Wednesday quoted the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry as saying.
Output of pig iron this year would be more than 100 million tonnes, while rolled steel output would rise two-three million tonnes compared with last year to 82-83 million tonnes, it said.

It quoted industry experts as saying the domestic steel market this year had been less sluggish than expected and the sales rate of steel and iron had reached 100 percent with stockpile falling, it said.
China would consume at least 98-99 million tonnes of rolled steel this year and possibly as much as 100 million tonnes, it said.
